questions.question: What gas is commonly produced when fuels containing carbon are burned?
options: Nitrogen
Carbon dioxide
Carbon monoxide only
Hydrogen

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the chemical composition of a carbon dioxide molecule?
options: Two carbon atoms and one oxygen atom
One carbon atom and one oxygen atom
One carbon atom and two oxygen atoms
Two carbon atoms and two oxygen atoms

questions.question: Approximately what percentage of Earth's atmosphere is made up of carbon dioxide?
Which of the following is classified as a greenhouse gas?
options: Nitrogen
Oxygen
Carbon dioxide
Helium

questions.question: What is the primary consequence of having too many greenhouse gases in the Earth's atmosphere?
options: An increase in average global temperature, known as global warming
A decrease in average global temperature, leading to a new ice age
A sudden increase in atmospheric oxygen levels
The complete destruction of the ozone layer within a year

questions.question: Why does coal burn so easily?
options: It is a sedimentary rock made mostly of carbon, with some impurities
It is a metamorphic rock composed entirely of pure sulfur
It is an igneous rock formed directly from volcanic lava
It is a liquid hydrocarbon that ignites at very low temperatures

questions.question: What organic matter is coal originally formed from?
options: Prehistoric marine plankton
Deep sediments of organic matter made of prehistoric plants
Ancient animal bones buried in desert sand dunes
Molten magma that cooled down slowly underground

questions.question: From what material did oil and natural gas form millions of years ago?
options: Prehistoric trees and land plants
Volcanic ash mixed with mineral salts
Dead plankton mixed in with sediments
Bones of large dinosaurs buried in mud

questions.question: How is sedimentary rock formed over geological time?
options: When molten rock cools down and solidifies on the surface
When sediment is buried and compressed, and salts from fluids cement the grains together
When existing rock is changed by intense heat and pressure without melting
When minerals crystallize directly from boiling water in geysers

questions.question: In which type of rock are fossils exclusively found?
options: Igneous rock only
Metamorphic rock only
Sedimentary rock, but not in other types of rock
Any type of rock, including igneous and metamorphic

questions.question: What are the two main gases that make up the vast majority of Earth's atmosphere?
options: 78% carbon dioxide and 21% oxygen
78% nitrogen and 21% carbon dioxide
78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen
78% oxygen and 21% hydrogen

questions.question: What is the chemical test used to identify carbon dioxide gas?
options: It relights a glowing splint.
It turns damp red litmus paper blue.
It burns with a squeaky pop sound.
It forms a white precipitate that turns limewater milky.

questions.question: How does the process of combustion affect the atmosphere?
options: It decreases the amount of nitrogen.
It increases the amount of carbon dioxide.
It increases the amount of oxygen.
It decreases the amount of water vapor.

questions.question: Which of the following processes reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
options: Respiration by animals
Combustion of fossil fuels
Photosynthesis by plants, phytoplankton and some bacteria
Decomposition of dead organic matter

questions.question: What happens to carbon dioxide when it interacts with the oceans?
options: It can dissolve in the oceans.
It immediately evaporates into space.
It reacts with water to form solid coal.
It is converted entirely into pure nitrogen gas.
